summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Templates dropdown in the WYSIWYG RichTextEditor on the admin Trust Sections editor. Drove the full flow via Playwright: admin login -> /admin/cases/{id} -> expand 'Trust Viewer Content' -> Add article (got index 4) -> verified Templates button + menu of exactly 6 items (Revocation, Successor Trustee, Spendthrift, No Contest, Powers of Trustee, Distribution to Beneficiaries) on BOTH trust (left) and explainer (right) editors -> inserted trust_html on left and explain_html on right (correct variants per editor) -> verified cursor-position insertion in the middle of typed text (AAA BBB | [Spendthrift block] | CCC) -> verified all 6 templates each insert non-empty distinct HTML -> verified outside-click closes dropdown -> verified Underline toolbar button now exists and works (produces <u>...</u>) -> Save shows 'Saved — 5 articles. Client notified.' toast -> reload persists the inserted No-Contest clause -> inline Preview toggle renders the inserted template HTML correctly. 12/12 critical Template scenarios PASS. No bugs found in the Templates feature.

issues:
document.execCommand('insertHTML') sometimes wraps the inserted block in the surrounding block format, producing a stray empty

tag right after the template heading (e.g. '

Revocation, Amendment, and Modification

\n

...'). Visually harmless (empty h3 collapses) but technically dirty HTML. Consider stripping/normalizing this in RichTextEditor.insertTemplate, or wrap insertion with a sentinel and re-flow blocks after execCommand.

action_items: (LOW) Normalize HTML emitted by insertTemplate to strip the duplicate empty <h3> artifact left behind by execCommand('insertHTML') when the caret is at the start of an empty block. Not blocking — visual output is unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: RichTextEditor.insertTemplate relies on document.execCommand which is officially deprecated. It still works in all current browsers (Chromium/Firefox/Safari Jan 2026) but consider migrating to a Range-based insertion (range.insertNode(fragment)) to (a) eliminate the empty-<h3> artifact and (b) future-proof against eventual removal.

saveSelection is called on blur and on the Templates button's onMouseDown — good. But if user clicks Templates without ever placing caret in editor, savedRangeRef is null and insertTemplate falls back to end-of-editor. That fallback works, but consider visually conveying 'inserted at end' to the user.
Templates dropdown does not trap focus or close on Escape. Low priority but improves a11y.
